findings.explanation: No cookie known to require consent was found, but 1 cookie(s) stored before any interaction could not be confirmed as exempt: xq_pref_v2 (unknown vendor, unknown, first-party). Their purpose has to be checked before drawing a conclusion.
No request to a known analytics or advertising service, and no unclassified beacon-like request, was observed before any interaction. No third-party site was contacted.

1 Web Storage key(s) written before any interaction look like identifiers or come from third parties and could not be classified: visitor_uid (localStorage of http://site.test:40693). Their purpose has to be checked.

No tracker requiring consent was observed and no consent interface was detected. A consent banner is only needed when non-exempt trackers are used, so its absence is not an issue in itself. Trackers that only load after an interaction would not have been observed.
No consent interface was detected, so there is no first layer to examine. Whether one is needed is covered by EP-04.
No analytics cookie was stored before consent, so no audience-measurement lifetime applies to this observation.
This point cannot be established by observing the website from outside. It is listed so a reviewer can examine it.
